requirement: Review fixes: stale clear, parsed host tie, token discovery, readback auth/error bodies

staleClear.behaviour: A successful gap refetch clears gap-stale only when the parsed snapshot is not an error; an HTTP-error snapshot (503) keeps stale. Tests cover observability and all nine readback routes, plus a failed local-logs gap keeps the banner.
staleClear.implementation: ObservabilityLoaded/ReadbackLoaded now set refresh live only for non-error snapshots.

parsedTie.behaviour: S26f test strips block/line comments and parses url.pathname ===/startsWith plus LOCAL_DIAGNOSTICS_PATH assignments; source.includes is no longer used.
parsedTie.proof: Commenting the observability registration makes the tie test fail; restored.

tokenDecision.decision: Implement legacy discovery: default shell reads role-model.learning.operator-token from localStorage; explicit observabilityToken/readbackToken override it. Empty storage sends no bearer.
tokenDecision.proof: S26h stored-token mount sends Bearer stored-token; readbackToken sends its own bearer.

authAndBodies.invalid: Malformed 200 bodies for requests/decisions/peers/queues/logs/runtime/session/candidates/receipts now render error, not empty.
